column1: # The words IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 lists in its Language Reference appendix "Reserved words" (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cobol-zos/6.4?topic=appendixes-reserved-words), each with the column it is marked in: 401 reserved, 52 standard-only, 62 potential.
# Only a reserved word is refused as a user-defined name: a standard-only word is reserved by the COBOL standard and not by Enterprise COBOL, and a potential one may be in a later release.
